name: gr_nordhaus_gaddum_mul
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : ℕ) (ha : G.Colorable a) (hb : Gᶜ.Colorable b) : Fintype.card V ≤ a * b
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : ℕ) (ha : G.Colorable a) (hb : Gᶜ.Colorable b), Fintype.card V ≤ a * b
informal: Nordhaus–Gaddum product bound χ(G)·χ(Gᶜ) ≥ n — with colourings c₁ : V → Fin a of G and c₂ : V → Fin b of Gᶜ the map v ↦ (c₁ v, c₂ v) is injective, since distinct u,v are adjacent in G or in Gᶜ; compare cardinalities.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : ℕ), G.Colorable a → Gᶜ.Colorable b → Fintype.card V ≤ a * b
